title: Claude Image Generation via MCP: 8 Connectors Compared by App and Plan

capabilityChecks.label: Runs a saved workflow in one request
Account sign-in with no API key
Generates on a free vendor account

tools.name: Wireflow
tools.tagline: Best overall for running a whole image workflow from one request
tools.claudeConnection: Custom connector by URL, OAuth sign-in
tools.modelSupport: 100+ image, video and audio models as nodes

quickstart.label: Add the Wireflow connector to Claude Code, from the wireflowINC/skills README. Then run /mcp to sign in. In Claude on the web, add the same URL as a custom connector.
quickstart.code: claude mcp add --transport http wireflow https://www.wireflow.ai/api/mcp

quickstart.label: Or install the open source Claude Code skills, from the same README. Each skill shows the credit cost and waits for your yes before a run.

tools.moneyPageLabel: Wireflow node based image generation page

tools.name: Comfy Cloud
tools.tagline: Best for ComfyUI workflows on cloud GPUs
tools.claudeConnection: Custom connector by URL, OAuth, API key fallback
tools.modelSupport: ComfyUI workflows, plus partner models such as Flux and Ideogram
tools.note: The linked repository holds Comfy's Claude Code plugins, including comfy-cloud. The hosted MCP connection itself is a service.

quickstart.label: Install the comfy-cloud plugin in Claude Code, from the Comfy MCP docs. Then run /mcp, select comfy-cloud and authenticate.
Or add only the connection, from the same page.
quickstart.code: claude mcp add --transport http comfy-cloud https://cloud.comfy.org/mcp

tools.name: Krea
tools.tagline: Best for Claude Code users who want many image models
tools.claudeConnection: Server URL, OAuth, API token fallback
tools.modelSupport: Krea's image and video models, and node apps
tools.note: Free tier is marked yes because the pricing page lists a free plan.

quickstart.label: Add the Krea MCP server to Claude Code, from Krea's MCP docs. Sign in with your Krea account when Claude Code asks you to connect.
quickstart.code: claude mcp add --transport http krea-ai https://api.krea.ai/mcp

tools.name: Figma
tools.tagline: Best for teams that already pay for Figma Weave
tools.modelSupport: A raster image tool and Figma Weave workflows
tools.note: The linked repository is Figma's setup guide for the MCP server, not server code. Free tier is marked yes because the pricing page lists a free Starter plan.

quickstart.label: Install the Figma plugin for Claude Code, which Figma's remote server setup page recommends.
Or add the remote server by hand, from the same page.
quickstart.code: claude mcp add --transport http figma https://mcp.figma.com/mcp

tools.name: Adobe for Claude
tools.tagline: Best for generating and then fixing a photo in one chat
tools.modelSupport: Scene generation, plus photo and design edits
tools.note: Free tier is marked yes because Adobe says many tools work without signing in. Adobe states no price for the connector, so no pricing link is listed.

quickstart.label: Connector URL from Anthropic's directory listing. Adobe's page says to add the Adobe plugin from Plugins in Claude, connect it on the Connectors tab, then type /adobe in a new conversation.

tools.name: Hugging Face
tools.tagline: Best for trying open models through Gradio Spaces
tools.modelSupport: Image tools from the Gradio Spaces you select
tools.note: The REST API column refers to Hugging Face Inference Providers, which are documented apart from the MCP server.

quickstart.label: Open your MCP settings while logged in, pick your client and copy the snippet the page generates, from the Hugging Face MCP docs.

tools.name: Higgsfield
tools.tagline: Best for creators who also want video models
tools.claudeConnection: Server URL from its MCP page

quickstart.label: Server URL from the Higgsfield MCP page. Follow the Claude or Claude Code tab on that page for the steps.

tools.name: Canva
tools.tagline: Best for designs you will keep editing
tools.note: The REST API column refers to Canva's Connect APIs for developers, which Canva documents apart from the connector.

quickstart.label: Connector URL from Anthropic's directory listing. Add it from the directory in Claude.
